title: Data to Value: An ‘Evaluation-First' Methodology for Natural Language Projects
reasoning: The paper proposes a new methodology, "Data to Value" (D2V), which explicitly integrates ethical evaluation as a core step in the project lifecycle. It includes two distinct "Ethics Review" phases (Phase 2 and Phase 19*) to assess "potential moral objections" and "morally questionable system functions and emergent properties (e.g. discrimination or unfairness)". This is a central component of the proposed process, not just a brief mention.
